title: Uwusaba Ahera .
intro: Mu masaha y’ijoro y’agacerere, umutima wihebeye Imana warahamagara Umunyambabazi mu bihome vyeranda vy’ahantu heranda. Imyaka y’ukwizera n’ukwihangana bidahungabana yari igiye guhembwa n’igitangaro cozana umunezero n’iragi ry’ubuhanuzi.
clues: Namara imisi yanje n’amajoro yanje nsenga mu rusengero rweranda, nguma nsenga Umukama wanje.
Narasaza, umugore wanje na we yari ingumba, yamara sinarigeze ntakaza icizigiro ku mbabazi za Allah.
Narahawe umuhungu, yitwa Yahya, aca aba umuhanuzi n’itara ry’ubugororotsi.
Nanje ubwanje nari umuhanuzi, narungitswe kuyobora bene Isirayeli.
Nari uruvyaro rwa Muhanuzi Haruni kandi nakora nk’umuherezi mu Rusengero.
Najejwe kwitwararika Mariyamu nyina wa Isa, kandi narabonye ibitangaro vyiwe.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Basubiye mu bantu babo bamaze gukizwa n'ifi .

verse: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous. (6:85)
